name: How long does a typical kitchen painting project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical kitchen painting project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standard kitchen wall and ceiling painting project usually takes between one and three days. The total duration depends on the extent of drywall repairs, cabinet taping, and cure times between coats. If your project includes kitchen cabinet painting, expect the timeline to expand to four to seven business days. Cabinet refinishing requires removing doors and hardware, extensive degreasing, scuff sanding, priming, and applying smooth finish coats with adequate dry time between stages. Working with an owner-operated crew that handles both drywall preparation and paint application helps keep these phases streamlined.
acceptedAnswer.description: Kitchen walls and ceilings take one to three days. Repainting kitchen cabinets typically takes four to seven days due to cleaning, hardware removal, sanding, priming, and curing.
